QuestInfo.name: Missing Each Other
QuestInfo.0: You knew it was coming, but it still stung that Mercedes doesn't remember you. You were able to get as far as you have thanks to Moonbean's help. It's already too late, but you should go see her before it's REALLY too late.
QuestInfo.2: As much as you miss Moonbeam, the spirit she lent you will gradually take after her.
